x: We scored major points in three of the five field events with our Latvian member, A. Bergvalds, winning both the Shot and Discus, and young A.

Godfrey and Maurice Jones carried on the good work by being first and second in the 1 mile, and Jones's finishing burst had to be seen to be believed! Wallington won the 4 x 110 yards Relay in the good time of 46.5 secs., and Alan Law was 2nd in the Junior Weight, while A.

Marshall, our Surrey Junior sprint champion, is now serving in the R.A.F. and is stationed at Hereford, and at the moment is not getting much chance to do any training. We do not seem to have had any news of A.
High Jump · A. J. Sinton · July, 1951 · 5ft. 6ins.
